#!name=Sub-Store
#!desc=Optional subscription manager; manual synchronization only. No scheduled task.
#!openUrl=https://sub.store
#!author=Peng-YM
#!homepage=https://github.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store

[Argument]
cors=input, "https://sub-store.vercel.app,http://substore.stash,https://substore.stash", tag=CORS允许来源, desc=允许浏览器跨域访问 Sub-Store 后端的 origin. 多个用 , 连接. 设为 * 可恢复旧行为

[MITM]
hostname=sub.store

[Script]
http-request ^https?:\/\/sub\.store\/((download)|api\/(preview|sync|(utils\/node-info))) script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-1.min.js, requires-body=true,max-size=-1, timeout=900, tag=Sub-Store Core, argument=[{cors}]
http-request ^https?:\/\/sub\.store(?=\/|$) script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sub-store-org/Sub-Store/d26e713e38901e02565a6505c1ae5cb8bb8a1a22/sub-store-0.min.js, requires-body=true,max-size=-1, timeout=900, tag=Sub-Store Simple, argument=[{cors}]
